helpWhat.serendipity: Finds images in the 'interesting but not too similar' mid-similarity zone relative to your reference images. Best for discovering new creative seeds.
helpWhat.arithmetic: Finds images close to the result of 'A+B−C' vector arithmetic. Captures the feel of 'somewhere between these two aesthetics' in embedding space.
helpWhat.morph: Reveals a 3-step concept gradient between images A and B. Shows 4 images at t=0.25, 0.50, and 0.75 for 12 results total.
helpWhat.anomaly: Finds images with WD14 tags that rarely appear with the reference tags. An LLM-generated 'rare tag' is injected into the query vector.
helpWhat.inversion: Finds images that share the same subject but with inverted world — mood, lighting, setting — as determined by VLM analysis.
helpWhat.discover: Finds images near the target that are close to the positive images and far from the negative images (Qdrant DiscoverQuery).
helpWhat.blend: Finds images in the direction of a weighted centroid of multiple reference images. Negative weights push away from that concept.
helpWhat.outlier: Antipode mode: finds images at the opposite end of the semantic space. Isolated mode: discovers the lowest-density points in UMAP 2D space.
helpWhat.grouped_search: Vectorizes a text query and returns representative images grouped by a specified field (model name, batch, etc.).
helpWhat.text_search: Converts a natural language description into an embedding vector and searches the full collection for semantically close images. No reference image required.

helpTip.serendipity: Tip: Using 2–3 reference images stabilizes the averaged vector, producing more intentional 'happy accidents'.
helpTip.arithmetic: Tip: Try running with just one + image first to establish a baseline, then layer in − or additional + images.
helpTip.morph: Tip: Set A to your current aesthetic and B to your target — the intermediate images show the transition path.
helpTip.anomaly: Tip: Results improve when reference images have rich WD14 tags. Run the AI pipeline first for best results.
helpTip.inversion: Tip: Narrow the axis selection for subtle variations. Inverting all axes at once gives a dramatic contrast.
helpTip.discover: Tip: You need at least 3 images total (1 target + 1 positive + 1 negative). The first slot is the target.
helpTip.blend: Tip: Setting a slider near 0 neutralizes that image's influence. Negative values push in the opposite direction.
helpTip.outlier: Tip: For antipode mode, use 2–3 reference images for a more stable 'opposite direction'. Isolated mode needs no reference.
helpTip.grouped_search: Tip: Set group_by to 'model_name' for per-model summaries or 'batch_id' for per-batch representative images.
helpTip.text_search: Tip: Descriptive scene text tends to work better than tag lists. Natural sentences help the embedding model capture your intent more precisely.
